external_sources.verified: Official Qt documentation confirms activation by system-configured mouse action and Return on Windows; actual native probes verify the current machine.
external_sources.adaptation: Use the mature native activation signal and original button route for both keyboard and mouse navigation.

decision: Keep mature Qt list/delegate/splitter controls and the existing exact fixed-map reader. These already implement the source-qualified identities needed here; adding a second renderer would duplicate state and navigation.
codebase_design_application: Verified battle input crosses a narrow object-reading interface; standalone and embedded callers share the same derivation.
